messages:
Mira Chen: Kicking off the Jupiter LoRA merge for customer 'Orbit' — hitting an odd token dropout on invoice-style prompts, posting quickpack results.
Samir Patel: Got the pack? paste the numbers pls.
Mira Chen: ```
quickpack: 200 customer invoice prompts
model: base-jupiter + LoRA (v2)
quant sim: fp16 -> int4 (simulation)
metrics (baseline -> merged):
- exact_match: 0.842 -> 0.793 (-4.9%)
- rougeL: 0.76 -> 0.71 (-6.6%)
- avg_token_ll: -2.12 -> -2.45
- latency p95: 112ms -> 95ms (int4 sim)
notes: numeric formatting drift: "$1,200.00" -> "$1200" (loss of comma)
```
Todd Nguyen: :warning: int4 sim looks optimistic for numeric tokens — did you run with tokenizer preservation flags? can you paste the quant command you used?
Mira Chen: used quick sim script, command below:
```
python tools/quant_sim.py --model base-jupiter --lora merges/lora_orbit_v2.pt --bits 4 --preserve-tokens "[",","]" --cache-warm 100
```
Samir Patel: cc @Jen Ortiz — customer cares about invoice amounts and payment terms, any prompt-level constraints we should test?
Jen Ortiz: saw hallucinated payment terms in earlier runs. Add targeted slot-extract evals for amounts, dates, invoice ids. Also test constrained decoding (allowlist digits/comma/period) and a few few-shot examples with format enforcement.
Mira Chen: adding targeted 500-prompt slotpack, will run blends at different alpha weights (0.5/0.6/0.7) and try int8 sim too. Will enable KV warmstart for streaming.
LMSRE: Smoke check finished — regressions above threshold for exact_match on slot-extract for Orbit, auto-creating triage ticket: infra/triage#1832.
eval-bot: Automated summary: exact_match regression +6% relative vs threshold, flagged. See S3: s3://redwood-evals/orbit/jupiter-lora/quickpack-1766667777/results.json
Samir Patel: So options: revert LoRA for Orbit, reduce merge alpha, or apply post-processing to normalize numeric formats. Which first?
Mira Chen: Plan: 1) try alpha=0.6 blend (current was 0.8) and re-run int8 sim 500 prompts; 2) if still bad, add a post-processing normalizer for amount tokens as a short-term mitigation; 3) fallback route to 'jupiter-lite' variant for Orbit during canary.
Todd Nguyen: I'll pin a routing policy to send Orbit prod traffic to dedicated variant 'jupiter-lite' for the canary window. Adding a temp feature flag.
Jen Ortiz: I'll craft the slot-extract prompt set and add 30 examples for format enforcement. Also want to run a few-shot with system message: "Always return amounts with commas as in locale en_US."
Mira Chen: Thanks — will post results in this thread when the 500-run completes. tagging @Samir, @Todd, @Jen :eyes:
Samir Patel: thx. keep it tight, customer is in the loop.
Mira Chen: Update (later): alpha=0.6 blend + int8 sim reduced exact_match delta to -2.1% and fixed most comma cases after adding post-processing. still running full regression sweep.
Mira Chen: Final: merging with alpha=0.6, enabling post-process amount normalizer, routing Orbit to 'jupiter-lite' for 24h canary. will schedule full eval report. :white_check_mark:
